master_requirements.scope: No engineering execution latency pass budget may be invented and described as already mandated by the master. Original300s worker timeout is a completion limit, not performance acceptance.

eligible_baseline_statistics.aggregation_limit: Equal3-repetition captures pooled descriptively; temporally distinct observations, not independent identically distributed samples or a confidence interval.
eligible_baseline_statistics.selection_rule: Freeze this complete identified set before new measurements. Never select only slower95.100s, silently exclude matching55.870s, or update the reference envelope after seeing12/13.

current_observations.disposition: Same-code candidate medians and same-code baseline captures vary materially. Matching metadata does not prove comparable ambient load or explain costs; no specific OS/sharing/antivirus cause is established.

semantic_reference.purpose: Exact unchanged source-bound semantic reference and recorded timing; reused evidence, never fresh baseline execution or qualification count.
semantic_reference.required_semantics: All3 samples passed, every semantic/reload identity check and input_stable flag true, unchanged300s worker limit and workload.

timing_reporting.required_comparisons: Every new candidate median and all3 sample values against named95.100s reference, frozen all9 pooled55.870s baseline, faster55.643s capture, both retained current8/current10 observations and immediately preceding new iteration. Report percentages and absolute differences without cherry-picking.
timing_reporting.older_current8_anchor: Keep68994.3492ms visible to avoid allowing cumulative deterioration by repeatedly moving the previous anchor.
timing_reporting.failure_observations: Preserve original incomplete baseline1/8/10 without fabricated timing; keep reliability outcomes separate from successful latency samples. Their small selected history is not a population failure-rate estimate.

supplementary_numeric_screen.formula: Investigate new_candidate_median_ms > 2 * frozen_pooled_baseline_median_ms + 250ms; also report against the faster matched baseline and previous candidate.
supplementary_numeric_screen.limit: This inherited-style broad investigation screen may detect gross costs but is not sufficient for no-unexplained-degradation or release acceptance. Current8/current10 being below it does not close their visible24–50% cost against the faster reference.

degradation_disposition.automatic_block: Any incomplete sample, worker error/timeout, false semantic check, stale binding, failed required gate, missing quietness evidence, or new accepted-feature regression stops candidate qualification; do not change budget or relabel until green.
degradation_disposition.timing_review: Any upward median change against the frozen pooled/fast baseline or previous candidate stays explicitly visible for independent disposition; simple sample overlap or remaining within historical max does not prove equivalent performance.
degradation_disposition.acceptable_resolution: Either fresh controlled evidence supports no material new degradation under a prospectively justified engineering tolerance, or independently review measured phase/CPU/work counts explaining and bounding necessary accepted feature cost plus its supported-use impact. Record uncertainty and actual observed limit. Do not accept unexplained deterioration solely because semantics passed,95.100s is slower, or300s timeout did not fire.
degradation_disposition.unresolved_action: If explanation/comparability or an explicitly justified bounded tolerance is still absent, retain EXECUTION_PERFORMANCE_REVIEW and withhold master53/release closure. A raw functional complete round is not automatically an accepted convergence round.

quietness.required: Document no concurrent measured benchmarks/tests/builds and owned-process/load/storage conditions immediately around each capture; keep original isolated controlled environment and ordered workloads.
quietness.limits: timing_qualified=true and equal dependency/OS metadata are declarations, not independent proof of quietness. No security-tool disabling/global machine changes or unproven external-cause claim is justified.

prospective_recommended_rules.two_round_scope: Labels12/13 only after independently reviewed prospective wrapper/reference binding; fresh candidate3-repeat execution and all other required candidate full gates each loop. Quality/UI/constrained baseline channels remain fresh as proposed. Preserve failed8/10 and unused9/11; never count reused reference or diagnostic as new round.

current_sufficiency.limit: Reference reuse permits a fair prospective measurement design; present evidence alone does not satisfy full acceptance/performance convergence.

limits: Original errors, failures and historical tails remain preserved at their own sources; no captures rebound or overwritten.
No claim of statistical significance, hardware-independent SLO, CPU equivalence, native/RSS measurement or known denial cause.
